notes: All values verified on the cited page on 2026-10-17 unless marked otherwise. 'secondary' means the source is not the vendor itself.

storageConditions.value: 16-32 C (61-90 F), 20-80% RH, 26 C wet bulb max
storageConditions.quote: Allowable storage conditions 16°C - 32°C (61°F - 90°F); 20% - 80% RH; 26°C (79°F) wet bulb max

storageConditions.value: Limited lifetime warranty
storageConditions.quote: Free from defects in manufacturing and material defects for the useful life of the product

storageConditions.value: 20,000 nominal load/unload cycles (Ultrium 9 and Ultrium 10 both 20,000)
storageConditions.quote: Nominal cartridge life: Load/unload cycles ... Ultrium 9 20,000 (20k)

storageConditions.value: 24 hours, or longer if needed to prevent condensation
storageConditions.quote: acclimate it to the operating environment for 24 hours or the time necessary to prevent condensation in the drive

storageConditions.value: Keep away from moisture and direct sunlight
storageConditions.quote: Do not expose the cartridge to moisture or direct sunlight.

storageConditions.value: Avoid stray fields above 100 oersteds
storageConditions.quote: Do not expose recorded or blank cartridges to stray magnetic fields of greater than 100 oersteds.

storageConditions.value: 15-25 C, 20-50% RH, 22 C max dew point
storageConditions.quote: Recommended Operating Environment** 15°C to 25°C 20% to 50% 22°C max

storageConditions.value: 15-35 C, 20-80% RH, 22 C max dew point
storageConditions.quote: Allowable Operating Environment** 15°C to 35°C 20% to 80% 22°C max

storageConditions.value: Above 52 C may cause permanent damage
storageConditions.quote: Local tape temperature in excess of 52°C may cause permanent tape damage

storageConditions.value: Short term 16-35 C / 20-80% RH; long term 16-25 C / 20-50% RH. Page text flattens the table, so which generation columns carry this split could not be confirmed.
storageConditions.quote: 16～35℃(Short Term)/16～25℃(Long Term) ... 20～80%RH(Short Term)/20～50%RH(Long Term)

storageConditions.value: 26 C max wet bulb (allowable operation, some generations); 22 C max dew point (LTO-9/10 columns, inferred)
storageConditions.quote: 26℃ (Max Wet Bulb Temperature) ... 22℃ (Max Dew Point Temperature)

storageConditions.product: LTO Ultrium 10 (40TB) data cartridge (press release 2025-12-22, updated 2026-01-19)
storageConditions.value: 15-35 C (extended from 15-25 C); humidity up to 80% at 15-25 C; up to 47% at 35 C
storageConditions.quote: extended from 15°C–25°C to 15°C–35°C

storageConditions.product: HPE Storage LTO-10 Ultrium 75TB RW Data Cartridge Q2080A (data sheet PSN1014894658WWEN, June 2025; copy hosted on a reseller CDN, hpe.com timed out)
storageConditions.value: 30 years (up to 30 years if stored at recommended conditions)
storageConditions.quote: including up to 30 years of archival life, if stored at the recommended storage conditions

storageConditions.value: No cycle count stated; HPE says it runs load/unload qualification tests
storageConditions.quote: HPE brand qualification test procedures (load/unload, shoeshine, drop testing and environmental stress testing)

storageConditions.value: 16-25 C, 20-50% RH (35 C / 80% RH if archiving under 6 months); 26 C max wet bulb
storageConditions.quote: Archive temperature should be between 16°C and 25°C (61°F to 77 °F) (35°C (95°F) if archiving < 6 months).

storageConditions.value: Store vertically; ship on edge. Note: same guide also says cartridges may be stacked up to 6 high, and elsewhere 'never stack them'.
storageConditions.quote: Media should be stored vertically.

storageConditions.value: At least 24 hours (8 h in shipping box, 8 h unpacked in case, 8 h out of case)
storageConditions.quote: Allow cartridges to acclimate for at least 24 hours prior to use

storageConditions.value: Keep 8-12 cm from high-current cables, power supplies, motors; data at risk above 40 gauss
storageConditions.quote: Recorded information could be lost if the magnetic field is greater than 40 gauss in air

storageConditions.value: Ship on edge, tape reel axis horizontal
storageConditions.quote: oriented on edge (tape reel axis horizontal) inside the final box

storageConditions.product: KB 000122049 How to handle backup tapes (last modified 2026-04-18)
storageConditions.value: Store and transport vertically, in case, never stacked
storageConditions.quote: Always pack the tape inside the case when not in use, always in an upright position and never stack them.

storageConditions.product: KB 000122049 How to handle backup tapes
storageConditions.value: 24 hours
storageConditions.quote: Before using the tape, allow it to cool to room temperature for 24 hours.

storageConditions.product: FAQ: How do I store my LTO tape cartridges safely?
storageConditions.value: Store on edge like books; horizontal storage stresses the tape pack
storageConditions.quote: Store tapes vertically, standing on their edge like books on a shelf.

storageSummary.verticalStorageRecommended: Yes, by Overland-Tandberg, Dell and MagStor (in case, on edge). IBM, HPE and Fujifilm data sheets checked do not address orientation.
storageSummary.archivalLifeYears: 30 (HPE LTO-10 data sheet). IBM data sheet gives a limited lifetime warranty but no year figure. Fujifilm 30-year figure seen only on retailer pages.

owc.lineageNote: Mercury Pro LTO (2020, Thunderbolt 3) is now sold as 'OWC Archive Pro' (Thunderbolt). OWC's manual is titled 'Archive Pro LTO | Mercury Pro LTO' and says 'Legacy OWC Mercury Pro LTO users can also follow these driver setup instructions.' No official rename announcement or date found.

launch.quote: for $4,499 and includes the myLTO® software, LTO-8 tape and cleaning cartridge

argestBundle.value: Shipped with ArGest Backup Desktop Edition from Aug 2021
argestBundle.quote: Mercury Pro LTO units ship with ArGest Backup Desktop Edition

lto9.value: LTO-9 version reviewed Feb 2022 at $6,299 direct from OWC (ArGest licence not included in that price)
lto9.quote: The price of the unit as reviewed here is $6,299 direct from OWC

mercuryProLTO.lto7: Sold today only under the Archive Pro name (see below); no Mercury Pro LTO-7 launch source found.

archiveProThunderbolt.what: Desktop Thunderbolt LTO drive enclosure with optional onboard SSD bay, extra Thunderbolt 3 port, Mini-SAS HD port and DisplayPort; LTFS tapes
archiveProThunderbolt.drive: IBM LTO Ultrium 9 mechanism in the LTO-9 model
archiveProThunderbolt.interface: Thunderbolt 3 (USB-C) host port up to 40Gb/s; drive talks SAS internally and needs the ATTO Express SAS HBA driver
archiveProThunderbolt.speed: LTO-9: up to 300MB/s native (750MB/s compressed) per OWC spec tab
archiveProThunderbolt.software: Hedge Canister included on '...H' SKUs (OWC calls it a $399 value); OWC-Hedge partnership announced Jan 2025
archiveProThunderbolt.os: macOS 11 Big Sur to macOS 26 Tahoe; Windows 10 64-bit, Windows 11, Windows Server 2022; Linux 'Yes'
archiveProThunderbolt.priceCaveat: macsales.com LTO-9 H price ($12,499.99) is about double third-party listings found in search (Full Compass $6,199.99 for OWCTBLTMP90000, no date). Re-check before publishing.
archiveProThunderbolt.discontinued: Non-Canister SKUs OWCTBLTMP90000 (LTO-9) and OWCTBLTMP80000 (LTO-8) show 'Sold Out'; the LTO-9 one says 'We're sorry, but this item is no longer for sale.'

archiveProEthernet.what: Network-attached LTO appliance: tape drive shared over 10Gb iSCSI using built-in ATTO XstreamCORE 8100T; LTFS
archiveProEthernet.ethernet: (2) 10GbE host ports (RJ45 / SFP+ per spec tab) plus (1) Gigabit maintenance port
archiveProEthernet.drive: IBM LTO Ultrium 9 in the LTO-9 model; launch release says 'IBM LTO-7, LTO-8, or LTO-9 made in Japan premium drive options'
archiveProEthernet.speed: LTO-9: up to 400MB/s native (1000MB/s compressed) per OWC spec tab
archiveProEthernet.software: Hedge Canister plus ATTO Xtend SAN v.7 Mac iSCSI Initiator (both listed under Includes)
archiveProEthernet.os: macOS 13 Ventura to macOS 26 Tahoe; Windows 10 64-bit, Windows 11, Windows Server 2022; Linux 'Yes'
archiveProEthernet.availability: LTO-8 in stock (1 left); LTO-9 'Ships: Pending' (schema OutOfStock); LTO-7 OWC10GLTMP07H 'no longer for sale'

reviews.takeaway: Tape economics look good, but managing many 18TB tapes is harder than it looks; $6,299 excluding ArGest licence.
reviews.quote: managing an extensive achieve of files over numerous 18TB tapes isn't as easy as it might appear

reviews.publication: Larry Jordan (larryjordan.com), 2021 (exact date not found; comments from Oct 2021)
reviews.takeaway: Well-built, user-upgradeable drive and SSD; recommended for media archiving despite upfront cost. Reviewer used a loaner unit.
reviews.quote: I'm very impressed with the Mercury Pro LTO.
